correctness.rationale: The positive-deficit mark law follows from the exact Poisson lower-tail factorial-ratio identity; the extreme Gamma quantile gives b_n h_n^2 asymptotic to a positive order log n and m_n h_n^2 to infinity in the large-quota regime. These bounds justify geometric domination and the uniform order-1/h_n falling-factorial approximation; hazard integration yields nQ_m(b+x/h) to exp(-x); independent Poissonized counts yield finite Poisson random measures. Monotone threshold-count bracketing transfers marks to deterministic samples because b h^2/n tends to zero. The packaged checker completed 276 deterministic exact/numerical assertions. Tests do not replace the proof. The assertion is at fixed x and under stated growth limits.

value.rationale: At the natural multi-coupon cutoff the unmarked probability of completion does not reveal how many additional copies are needed. The theorem classifies this natural shortfall workload into Poisson, geometric compound-Poisson, and rescaled exponential compound-Poisson regimes, with a precise scale transition at m_n proportional to log n. It gives a motivated occupancy structural boundary, not merely a numerical or artificial invariant.
